hazard: Stormwater and river water around a low-lying city
topEvent: Water exceeds the drainage and flood-defence capacity of the zone

metadata.label: SYNTHETIC
metadata.parameterBasis: Illustrative simulation frequencies, conditional probabilities, PFD defaults and assumed independence only; not measured rates, forecasts, hydraulic modelling or a QRA. Severity bands follow PRD 6.1-D.
metadata.healthBasis: Initial simulated generator backup Health is Degraded with an overdue monthly load test; pumping-stations remains Healthy until a person accepts a later Health Proposal.
metadata.crossDomainNote: A pump-SCADA Cyber/OT Bowtie may later link to pump-station-outage; no Cross-Domain Link is seeded without that source Bowtie.
